Rem scaling

This page sets the document root font-size to forty percent, a common rem-scaling technique. If the reader's typography were sized in rem it would shrink along with the page and become unreadable, so the reader uses an absolute base and em units internally to stay isolated.

This second paragraph adds enough prose for the extractor to confidently treat the page as an article and rebuild it, so the test can measure the computed font size of a reader paragraph and confirm it is the intended eighteen-pixel base rather than a tiny fraction of it.

A third paragraph keeps the cleaned body length comfortably above the extraction threshold so the reader activates reliably on this page during the test run.
